author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Stream the enterprise audit log to an Amazon S3 bucket (Enterprise settings > Audit log > Log streaming) and read the bucket with a Sophos NG-SIEM S3 Ingest (customer-managed) integration. GitHub writes gzip files of JSON lines, one event per line; Sophos doesn't document whether its forwarding function reads gzip files, so check that the first events arrive. Sign-ins, failed sign-ins, sign-outs and 2FA challenges go to Auth (GitHub logs these only for Enterprise Managed Users); every other event (git, repository, organization, enterprise, token and policy changes) goes to CloudAudit with the action as the event name. Source IP addresses appear only after Enable source IP disclosure is turned on. The Azure Event Hubs stream's message format isn't documented, so it isn't covered. Samples follow the fields in GitHub's audit log docs with made-up values. Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 (121 of 121 fields matched the emulator), and the parent's confirm string picked the same events there. Each child also passed Run Test as a separate parser under its parent. No built-in parser claimed these events in 11 Run Tests.
